title: Private Nashville Suite w/ Parking & Huge Shower
description:
Enjoy your own private Nashville retreat with a separate entrance and convenient free parking. Perfect for couples, solo travelers, or business visitors, this comfortable guest suite gives you a quiet place to relax after exploring Music City. 

Rated in the top 1% of all homes on AirBnB, past guests highlight the comfort of the bed and the easy access to the private entrance.

The huge bathroom features a spacious walk-in shower, double vanity, and plenty of room to get ready.

The space
Your space is completely separate, with your own entrance and no shared indoor spaces.

Start the day with coffee or tea, with both a Keurig and drip coffee maker available. The kitchenette also includes a refrigerator/freezer, microwave, filtered hot and cold water, dishes, glassware, and the basics you need for simple meals and snacks.

Sleep comfortably in a cozy queen bed with fresh linens and plenty of pillows.

Guest access
The entire suite is yours alone. It's attached to the house but is completely private and sealed off from the main house. It has its own private entrance. There's a backyard and grill you are welcome to.

Park right outside your private door and come and go independently using keypad entry.

Other things to note
Travel times depend heavily on Nashville traffic times.

3 miles to BNA Nashville Airport

9 miles to Broadway / Bridgestone Arena / Grand Ol Opry

9 miles to Opryland Mall

10 miles to Vanderbilt
